entry.title: We analyzed how ChatGPT and DeepSeek recommend action camera brands
entry.summary: We asked the AI models behind ChatGPT and DeepSeek about action cameras 118 times. DJI, GoPro and Insta360 own the answers, and Insta360 is named last.

entry.title: We analyzed how ChatGPT and DeepSeek recommend gold jewellery brands in Singapore
entry.summary: We asked the AI models behind ChatGPT and DeepSeek where to buy jewellery in Singapore 139 times. SK Jewellery was named in 97% of answers and never ranked first.

entry.title: The candidate message scored no better than the current one.
entry.summary: A global hotel group wanted to rewrite its executive-lounge pitch. We tested the rewrite first. It scored no better, so it was shelved.
